items.headline: Bengals force 4 turnovers, Burrow throws for TD in 33-27 win over the Buccaneers
items.description: — The Bengals' new-look defense forced four turnovers — including its first fumble recovery for a TD since 2022 — Joe Burrow passed for 254 yards and a touchdown and Cincinnati defeated the Tampa Bay Buccaneers 33-27 Sunday.
